# P35.28 — Officer-naming gate on the publication path, default deny (PUB-007, H-9)

**Requirement ids:** **SIG-PUB-007** (owner — the five-prong officer-naming test now binds the publication path: a public-employee name publishes only when all five prongs hold per a *persisted* decision, replayed at gate time — the stored flag is never trusted) · **SIG-PUB-008** (cited — publication requires two *independent* reviewers' written concurrence; the registry records it, a dissent/single-reviewer/non-independent/duplicate record withholds; the sole-maintainer posture of ADR-163 stands — WV-03 waived only the HG-11 second-reviewer *role*, never this rule, and this run signs no naming decision) · **SIG-PUB-009** (cited — `is_home_address` is categorical, outside the test; the flag travels the record and denies regardless of stored `permitted`) · **SIG-PUB-010** (cited — `is_routine_audit_row` the same; the refusal is recorded verbatim) · **SIG-PUB-017** (cited — the gate composes concur-record AND `publication_permitted`; unknown/restrictive jurisdictions withhold even over a valid concurrence).

**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/286_P35.28__officer-naming-gate-default-deny.md` (manifest row 286, Round 11 / P35, sub-round 11B; `R11-SAFE-03`, F2a §5 group 1 + E1/NEW-12 merged) · **Base:** `r11/P36.11-grant-council-procurement-documents-bills` (`0f9bb256`) · **Branch:** `r11/P35.28-officer-naming-gate-default-deny` · **OM-20 posture:** none — code, a committed data record, fixtures and tests only; no deploy, no fetch, no `ingestion_permitted` flip, no gate ticked, **no naming decision signed**. Live legs: none.

## Why

Today `evaluate_officer_naming` runs only at OKC ingest; the export/web publication path applied only the SIG-PUB-017 jurisdiction rule, so a `isPublicEmployeeName` row with no concurrence record could render — the OKC dossier fixture hard-coded "Chief Wade Gourley" shown, `publication.test.ts` asserted a US name publishable, and (drift found at load) the dossier **print** and **JSON** surfaces never called `applyPublicationPolicy` at all (the E1/NEW-12 defect class — wider than the ticket states). This row routes every public-employee-name row through the §43.4 test backed by a persisted two-reviewer decision and makes the gate default-deny: no recorded concurrence → withheld, whatever the jurisdiction says. No real concurrence exists (the OKC `concurrence.md` is sole-maintainer self-concurrence — not independent), so the registry starts honestly empty and the Gourley row flips to withheld.

## What ships

- **`sig.officer-naming-decisions/1`** (`policy/src/policy/data/officer_naming_decisions.json`) — the committed append-only decision registry: schema tag, policy block, `decisions: []`. Entries carry `subject_id`/`predicate_id` match keys, all five prong evaluations, the reviewers' written positions, the carve-out flags, `recorded_at`/`recorded_by`, a content-derived `ond-<sha256[:24]>` id and a `supersedes` pointer. Supersede is append-a-new-record, never an edit (P1–P3).
- **`policy/src/policy/officer.py`** — the persisted side of the single decider: `OfficerNamingRecord` + wire (de)serialization, `load_naming_decisions` (schema-checked, fail-loud on a malformed table), `latest_decision_for` (append order IS supersede order), `evaluate_record`/`record_concurs` (replays `evaluate_officer_naming` over the stored inputs — an inconsistent record, a bare `permitted: true`, or a carve-out flag all deny), `decision_to_record` (the ingest→persist serializer), `append_decision` (the only write path: validated, append-only, refuses inconsistent/duplicate/orphan-supersedes records), `employee_name_publishable` (record concur AND `publication_permitted` — both legs or withhold, with the refusal reason recorded).
- **`connectors/src/connectors/okc_documents.py`** — `assert_person_naming_permitted` gains additive `subject_id`/`record_sink`/`recorded_by` kwargs (existing callers unchanged — signature compatible); `okc_claim` gains `naming_record_sink` pass-through, so the ingest evaluation emits the SAME serialized record the publication gate reads — one decision object, not two evaluations. Permit and refusal are both recorded (§3.1).
- **`exports/src/exports/web_dossier.py`** — `_gate_public_employee_names` post-pass inside `build_web_dossiers`: every flagged name row is gated at the builder, so page/print/JSON/index all inherit it; permit carries `namingDecisionId` provenance, withhold clears the value, sets `withheld` and records the reason (never silently dropped). Both name rows gain stable `subject_id`/`predicate_id`.
- **`web/src/lib/officer-naming.ts`** — the faithful TypeScript mirror: schema-checked reader of the committed JSON (bundled at build time), `latestDecisionFor`, `replayNamingDecision` (never trusts the bare flag), `namingRecordPermits`.
- **`web/src/lib/dossier.ts`** — `applyPublicationPolicy` composes BOTH legs (jurisdiction AND persisted concurrence); can only ever withhold. **`web/src/lib/data.ts`** — `getDossiers()` applies the gate in the single data funnel, closing the ungated print/JSON/map surfaces (the recorded drift). **`web/src/lib/publication.ts`** — the jurisdiction map aligned verbatim to `jurisdictions.toml` (US/US-CA/UK true; EU/FR/DE/BE false; default false — conservative).
- **Fixtures** — `dossier-fixture.ts`, `dossier-jurisdiction-fixture.ts` carry the match keys on the name rows.
- **Tests** — `tests/unit/test_officer_naming_gate.py` (13: registry schema, malformed refusal, round-trip/replay, inconsistency, carve-outs, supersede/latest-wins, default-deny ×4 jurisdictions, concur+US permit, restrictive/unknown deny, append writer refusals); `tests/connectors/test_okc_documents.py` +2 (sink emits the same record for permit and refusal; `okc_claim` routes it); `tests/exports/test_officer_naming_gate_exports.py` (3: builder withholds unrecorded, shows a recorded concur with `namingDecisionId`, withholds on deny and on FR regardless); `web/tests/unit/publication.test.ts` rewritten (record-gated matrix, TS-mirror replay, funnel coverage); `jurisdiction.spec.ts` US leg + `jurisdiction.nojs.spec.ts` new US leg assert the name is absent from built HTML.
- **ADR-209** — the owned decision: the committed `sig.officer-naming-decisions/1` table as carrier (the `sig.publication-withdrawals/1` precedent — read verbatim by Python and TS; the ADR-124 `publication_disposition` spine mirror rides when a live spine carries the claim); withhold-not-refuse at the builder; the registry stays the operator's record. ADR_TRIGGERS.csv row + BACKLOG BL-085 mapping appended.

## Out of scope

The naming decisions themselves (the operator's recorded two-reviewer act — never produced, signed or drafted by this run); any live deploy of the gate (lands with the next export/web build); SIG-PUB-017's matrix itself (P37.69a owns it — the web map was aligned to `jurisdictions.toml` only as the contract permits); Part VIII at-rest screening (P34.49/P36.15); the ADR-163 waiver boundary (cited, never edited); the `publication_disposition` spine mirror leg (no live spine carries the claim — recorded in ADR-209).
